summary.headline: Alcochoden and the Lunar Nodes
summary.text: Rules for reducing the Alcochoden’s indicated years according to angularity, oriental or occidental position, peregrination, retrogradation, combustion, and other planetary impediments. The Moon’s Dragon head adds a quarter of the years and its tail subtracts one; Ptolemy is cited, with Jupiter and Venus in the Ascendant or midheaven offering hope of longer life.
